text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Satono Crown,
she stepped away to take a phone call, and while I was waiting for her—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting, Trainer!
Hey, remember those measures for the tailor contest?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Remember, we asked Earth-san to provide live music for the fashion show, right?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That phone call just now was to say the proposal went through!
Directly from Papa himself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That takes care of a high-impact opening ceremony!
Next is the substance—we need a main attraction for the tournament.

The tournament host is her father's company.
I told her it might be a good idea
to emphasize the 'Satono family style.'

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Being true to oneself, huh...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Speaking of the Satono family, their technological prowess comes to mind...
It might be interesting to exhibit new technology
that could be utilized in the tailoring industry.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Dia would probably know a lot about this sort of thing. She worked on the Umulator too, so I'm sure she'll be a big help!

Afterward, we filled Satono Diamond in
and joined up with her, and the meeting began.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—So, I was thinking, how about a dress-up app
that uses the smartphone's camera?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it's for business negotiations, not play, you know?
I just thought it'd make holding meetings with distant clients
much easier.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"It tracks your whole body in real time,
allowing you to freely edit the design within the app—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If we make good use of this, it'll lower the hurdle for custom orders,
and we'll definitely get more customers!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
In that case... maybe the Umalator's scanning technology
will be useful? It was developed to be applied
to a wide range of situations, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Hao! Alright Dia, would you mind helping me draft the proposal?
choice_data_list: I wonder if there's anything I can do to help?
Is there anything I can do too?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I have a very important role to play!

As instructed by Satono Crown,
I changed into a suit and stood in the center of the photo booth.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, it suits you perfectly!
choice_data_list: Um, what are we going to do now...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's take the photos for the proposal.
Please strike the poses as instructed.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright, first, could you stand
with your feet about shoulder-width apart?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looking good!
You're really getting the hang of it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
OK! Next, put your right hand on your hip, okay?
Cross your legs slightly,
and make an S-curve with your body!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, perfect! Looks like you're getting the hang of it!
Your expressiveness has improved too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Good work! Now then,
could you change into the next outfit?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course! To make sure its functions come across,
I need to include photos of various outfits in the proposal!

And so, following Satono Crown's directions,
we continued taking photos.

And after sending the completed proposal to her father,
I was on my way home when—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, an email from Papa!
He says, 'I'll try negotiating with the group'!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: That's great, Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: This is all thanks to the cooperation of the two of you as well. After all, the proposal was created by the three of us!
choice_data_list: I hope it can be put to practical use.
I hope it can be put to practical use.
Playing the model was a little embarrassing, though.
Playing the model was a little embarrassing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: This is all thanks to the cooperation of the two of you as well. After all, the proposal was created by the three of us!
choice_data_list: I hope it can be put to practical use.
I hope it can be put to practical use.
Playing the model was a little embarrassing, though.
Playing the model was a little embarrassing, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I believe it will exceed your expectations.
The Satono family's tech division is top-notch, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it'll draw attention to Father's company.
Which means it contributes to the Satono family too♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
One more big push until the Tailor Tournament!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: No problem! That's my answer after strictly checking not just the proposal, but the reference photos as well, you know?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Getting the OK means that it has met
the required standard.
Please rest assured.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Exactly! The suit looked great on you,
so have a little more confidence♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...I know! You might even do great in our company's commercials!
I'll recommend you, saying you'd put real models to shame!"
